parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const rows=r.rows||r.input?.rows||[];const metrics=r.metrics||r.input?.metrics||[];if(!Array.isArray(rows)||!Array.isArray(metrics)||!metrics.length) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C5-D',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'MISSING_ROWS_OR_METRICS',message:'rows[] and metrics[] are required.'},next_action:'provide_metrics'}}];const out={};for(const m of metrics){const vals=rows.map(x=>Number(x?.[m.field])).filter(Number.isFinite);let v=null;switch(m.op){case 'count':v=rows.length;break;case 'sum':v=vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);break;case 'avg':v=vals.length?vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length:null;break;case 'min':v=vals.length?Math.min(...vals):null;break;case 'max':v=vals.length?Math.max(...vals):null;break;default:v=null;}out[m.id||`${m.op}_${m.field||'rows'}`]=v;}return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C5-D',component_version:'v1',kpis:out,row_count:rows.length,next_action:'publish_kpi_summary',error:null}}];
